game.desc: Lego Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy on Xbox 360 is an action game in which we find the little yellow men retracing the origins of the saga of George Lucas. You'll find A New Hope, The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi in a single game where you can control any character in the series and redo the levels with anyone. Use the power of the Force and your lightsaber to defeat Darth Vader.
